audit.why: Favoured 4/10 matches the 57.71% WR over 3405 games; early lane is dominant, side lane and late tighten as Ryze's mana stacking arrives — the prose says so.
Spikes correctly place Syndra's peak at first item and Ryze's ramp at 2+ mana items; level 6 asymmetry (kill ult vs Realm Warp utility) is stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability names are real, but breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and three Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted from unrelated fields, so the core Rune Prison/Flux sequencing was never keyed to actual cooldowns (W 11s>9s, E 3.5s, Q 5s, R 180s).
audit.why: Ryze's root only exists when Spell Flux has tagged you first; his W is 11s at rank 1 — that window is the lane's clock and the page never gave the number.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with rank numbers; bleed bullets replaced with range-keyed facts (Q 800 vs his 615 trade range, Realm Warp 3000-range gank portal).

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. It governs your forward steps. - E Scatter the Weak spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1, 9s maxed, and only roots if Spell Flux tagged you first — the ten seconds after he wastes it are your trade window. - His E cycles every 3.5s, so never sit in minion range debuffed. - Your E is 15s: spent on poke, the dive answer is gone.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Ryze must step to 615 range to trade back — your 800-range Q taxes every last-hit for free.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Spheres on the ground turn E into an instant stun and feed R's execute — a bare Syndra threatens nothing; a stocked one owns the lane.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Realm Warp is 3000 range — with your ult down he can portal his jungler onto an over-extended Syndra, and you have no dash to answer.

edits.before: No permanent owner here — the level chart shows where momentum tilts and tilts back.
edits.after: The chart is yours at every stage — Ryze's weak early never buys him a window in lane.

edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): 11s at rank 1, 9s max — a point-blank 615-range root; respect the EQ chain that follows it. - E Scatter the Weak (15s) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the 120s R for the fight that decides something.
